_note: MadeEA OS config. Written 2026-07-27. Routes the AI Agent Mastermind through the local OmniRoute gateway (http://localhost:20128) so every agent runs free with no API key. Delete a roomAgents entry to send that agent back to its OpenRouter default.
_username_note: Change this to your first name — it is shown in the Agent Room and Mastermind.
_model_note: All agents share oc/deepseek-v4-flash-free — verified working 2026-07-27. OmniRoute advertises 99 models but most are unreachable: aug/* needs the 'auggie' CLI installed, ddgw/* (DuckDuckGo) is rate-limited, tllm/* returns 403, and the auto/* combos were exhausting their fallback chains. Three aliases that appear in /v1/models are not even valid combos: auto/gemini, auto/llama, auto/glm. Personality still differs per agent — that comes from each agent's persona prompt, not the model.
_model_retry_note: Free pools fluctuate. If replies start failing, re-test with: curl -s http://localhost:20128/v1/chat/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"oc/big-pickle","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"stream":false}' and swap in whichever model answers.
